item.text: {"program_id":"qtclustering_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_hybrid_r3","verdict":"invalid","issue_categories":["missing_start_synchronization","missing_rank_aggregation","rank_local_timing"],"confidence":"high","timed_region":"Benchmark execution is timed from the pre-computation MPI_Barrier through qtClustering and the post-computation MPI_Barrier at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1507-1515. Validation, result serialization, and statistics occur afterward.","start_synchronization":"MPI_Barrier is called at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1507, but each rank starts its local clock only after independently returning from the barrier at line 1508. Barrier return is not proven simultaneous, so rank 0 can start after another rank has already begun work.","stop_synchronization":"MPI_Barrier at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1512 ensures all ranks have returned from qtClustering before their local stop at line 1513. CUDA work is completed before qtClustering returns through blocking device-to-host copies and cleanup, including lines 1262-1264, 1337-1338, and 1356.","rank_aggregation":"No aggregation is performed on the elapsed durations. The MPI_Allreduce calls at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1218 and 1282 aggregate clustering-selection state, not timing. Rank 0 prints only its own duration.","reported_value":"The canonical label at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1531 reports rank 0's local cluster_time.count() in milliseconds, not the maximum elapsed duration across ranks.","semantic_equivalence_basis":"This is distributed cooperative work, not independent complete-result replication: seeds are partitioned round-robin across ranks at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1147-1149, and ranks cooperate through global selection reductions and member-list broadcasts at lines 1218, 1282, and 1297-1301. Therefore the canonical time must represent the global completion time.","evidence":[{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1147-1149","finding":"Candidate seeds are partitioned across MPI ranks, establishing distributed rather than independent replicated computation."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1218-1220, 1282-1285","finding":"MPI collectives coordinate global clustering decisions, but do not aggregate elapsed times."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1507-1515","finding":"Each rank measures its own interval around qtClustering; the barrier does not guarantee simultaneous clock starts."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1530-1532","finding":"Only rank 0 prints its local cluster_time under the canonical Clustering time label."}],"timing_only_fix_possible":true,"minimal_fix":"After computing each rank's local duration, perform MPI_Reduce with MPI_MAX to rank 0 and print the reduced maximum instead of rank 0's local cluster_time. The existing stop barrier may remain.","notes":"The millisecond unit and integer display are otherwise appropriate; the defect is the missing global maximum aggregation and resulting root-local reporting."}
